# فهد غصن | Fahad Gsn

> Luxury Handcrafted Woodwork & Bespoke Furniture Atelier — Kuwait | مشغل الأعمال الخشبية الفاخرة والأثاث المخصص — الكويت

Fahad Gsn is a boutique artisan woodworking atelier based in Kuwait City, Kuwait, founded by master wood craftsman Fahad Gsn. The atelier transforms rare, sustainably sourced raw timber slabs (American Black Walnut, Ancient Olive Wood, Burmese Teak, and Aged European Oak) into heirloom-grade furniture and sculptural collector pieces using traditional hand-joinery, golden architectural proportions, and organic botanical oil finishes.

## Primary Pages & Navigation

- [Home](https://fahad-gsn.ahmednasr-ca.workers.dev/): Atelier overview, featured limited-edition pieces, craft philosophy, and Kuwait studio intro.
- [Gallery](https://fahad-gsn.ahmednasr-ca.workers.dev/gallery): Full catalog of handcrafted woodwork, bespoke dining tables, consoles, sculptures, and custom commissions.
- [Reels & Craft in Motion](https://fahad-gsn.ahmednasr-ca.workers.dev/reels): Video documentation, carving process, grain surfacing, and behind-the-scenes timber transformation.
- [Private Concierge Visit](https://fahad-gsn.ahmednasr-ca.workers.dev/concierge): Private VIP consultation booking to inspect raw slabs and plan bespoke commissions directly with the artisan.
- [About Atelier](https://fahad-gsn.ahmednasr-ca.workers.dev/about): Story of Fahad Gsn, woodworking ethos, timber species guide, and sustainable finishing standards.
- [Contact](https://fahad-gsn.ahmednasr-ca.workers.dev/contact): Direct inquiry form, WhatsApp line, telephone, and studio location details.

## Craft & Technical Standards

- **Hardwood Species**: American Black Walnut (Juglans nigra), Ancient Wild Olive (Olea europaea), Burmese Teak (Tectona grandis), European Quercus Oak (Quercus robur).
- **Finishing Standard**: Solvent-free pure botanical oils, organic citrus terpenes, and natural unbleached beeswax. Zero toxic polyurethane topcoats.
- **Architectural Proportions**: Custom commission design guided by classical Golden Ratio proportions.
- **Studio Location**: Kuwait City, State of Kuwait.
- **Direct Phone & WhatsApp**: +965 98908022
- **Official Inquiries**: info@fahadgsn.com
